status: EXPLORATORY, declared after the screen generations existed and after the frozen index/predictions were hashed, but BEFORE its own outcome was computed or read
question: Is the Slovene residual governed by HOW MANY layers an edit covers, or by WHICH layers it reaches?
motivation: The pre-registered P2 pairs use STRIDED full-depth sets (S2, S4) as the broad-and-weak arms, so 'broad' is confounded with 'spread through bands that on their own do nothing'. This analysis separates coverage count from band identity on the SAME cells, with no new generations.

analyses.a: per-coverage-set dose-response: which sets ever reach SL judged harmful refusal < 0.5 and at what energy
analyses.b: matched-energy (within 15% in log energy) CONTIGUOUS vs STRIDED pairs: mean SL difference, pair bootstrap CI, sign test
analyses.c: OLS of the SL residual on per-band coefficient mass, holding log energy and the English residual fixed (reference band 37-48), cell bootstrap CIs; the same model for the EN residual

reporting: labelled EXPLORATORY in every table; it does not enter the Holm family and cannot rescue a failed P1/P2
